request: Test replay behavior when events arrive out of sequence.

defects.description: Events are applied as they arrive instead of waiting for missing sequence numbers, so delivering sequence 2 before 1 leaves the state at the older value.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { Replay } from "./src/replay.js"; const now = Date.now(); const replay = new Replay(); replay.apply({ seq: 2, value: "complete", at: now }); replay.apply({ seq: 1, value: "started", at: now }); console.log(JSON.stringify(replay.state));'

defects.why_missed: The happy-path suite only applies consecutive events in order, so it never creates a missing sequence gap.

traps.description: Events older than five minutes are intentionally ignored under the documented retention policy.
